newsitem.title: MEXICO: Empaques Ponderosa holders okay merger.
newsitem.headline: Empaques Ponderosa holders okay merger.

text.p: Mexico's Empaques Ponderosa SA de CV said Monday its shareholders attending an extraordinary meeting approved its merger with Servicios Especializados Tecnico Administrativos SA de CV.
The company said the merger, which is to become effective Dec 31, will take place through a capital increase in Empaques Ponderosa with the issue of new shares.
It said Servicios Especializados controlled 99.9 percent of the capital of Aluprint SA de CV, which makes consumer product packaging materials.
